_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS layer (dth-sc) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`; read by check:wireframes through dth-sc's site directory (docs/). `archimate-pages` draws the ArchiMate pages gen-archimate-pages.ts writes for the `archimate` visualiser in dth-sc.json. A stopgap (owner, 2026-11-17, dth-sc#50): a shared wireframe beside the renderer in cat-harness-tools is to cover every layer's archimate-pages visualiser, and this one is removed once dth-sc re-pins to it. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from folio-assistant-core/docs/wireframes/.
